title: Fujairah Tanker Sabotage
description: Four commercial oil tankers sabotaged off the coast of Fujairah near Strait of Hormuz.

title: Gulf of Oman Tanker Attacks
description: Attacks on Front Altair and Kokuka Courageous tankers in Gulf of Oman; insurance premiums spike.

title: Stena Impero Seizure

title: US-Iran Military Escalation
description: Regional missile strikes following Soleimani killing; maritime and aviation alert levels elevated.

title: WHO Declares COVID-19 Pandemic
description: Global lockdowns trigger blank sailings, trade drop, followed by extreme port congestion and equipment shortages.

title: Ever Given Suez Canal Grounding
description: Ultra Large Container Vessel Ever Given blocks Suez Canal for 6 days, trapping over 400 ships.

title: Outbreak of Russia-Ukraine War
description: Black Sea blockades, European airspace closures, sanctions and global rerouting of oil and grain flows.

title: Panama Canal Severe Drought Restrictions
description: Historic drought forces Panama Canal authority to slash daily transits, shifting some US-Asia trade to Suez.

title: Outbreak of Gaza War
description: Regional escalation begins, sparking heightened geopolitical tensions across Middle East transport corridors.

title: Galaxy Leader Hijacking
description: First commercial vessel seized in southern Red Sea, triggering direct maritime threat alert.

title: Major Liners Halt Red Sea Transits
description: Maersk, MSC, CMA CGM and Hapag-Lloyd officially divert container fleets to Cape of Good Hope.

title: Operation Prosperity Guardian
description: Multinational maritime security coalition deployed to protect commercial shipping.

title: US-UK Strikes on Military Sites in Yemen
description: Targeted airstrikes commence; maritime war risk premiums surge above 1% of vessel value.

title: MSC Aries Seizure & Iran-Israel Strikes
description: IRGC boards MSC Aries container ship near Hormuz; unprecedented direct drone/missile engagement.

title: Port of Hodeidah Infrastructure Strike
description: Direct airstrikes on fuel and port storage facilities in Hodeidah reinforce long-term diversion.

title: Regional Missile Exchanges & Airspace Alerts
description: Massive ballistic missile barrages and airspace closures force widespread commercial rerouting.

title: Institutionalization of Cape Route ("New Normal")
description: Global alliances (Gemini, Ocean Alliance) solidify long-term Cape of Good Hope network schedules.

title: Hormuz Tanker Escort Protocol Alerts
description: Heightened maritime surveillance and naval patrols instituted across Gulf energy transit lanes.
